alt: A compact living room corner with a patterned animal rug in sage and terracotta, cream walls holding a small framed watercolor, multiple throw pillows resting against each other, and a low walnut shelf displaying books, woven baskets, and potted plants.
text:
The animal rug corners the chair.

Three pillows, all different, lean against each other. Small paintings share a shelf with books. Kept this way by the person in it.
